name: @wrongieisright/byteme-herald-core
description: Shared framework for the ByteMe (Whiteout Survival) and Herald (Kingshot) Discord bots: shared SQLite schema and queries, proactive-message tracking, the DST-aware scheduler, the redemption engine, gift-code detection, the Telegram watcher, the dashboard skeleton, and the player-registry sync/backfill.

scripts.test: for f in test/*.test.js; do echo "=== $f ==="; node --test "$f" || exit 1; done
